items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Kit Orrie's band and what Kerry and those people, did they have any influence out there? Well, yes, they had a great influence on me.

ctx.x: He was the chap I used to play with most of all before I joined the Johnson band. Mm-hmm. He is a very keen cornet player. But, he was rough. He was pretty awful for a while. I can remember playing with him and thinking, oh, gosh, this is no value at all. He's so far off. He's sort of very keen, but he just can't get it. Suddenly, it all came. Obviously, he'd been practicing and thinking about it, but these things take time. Suddenly, it all sort of came to his fingertips and the 1948 Jazz Convention, he suddenly…
What about Kit Orrie's band and what Kerry and those people, did they have any influence out there? Well, yes, they had a great influence on me.

I heard very early in the piece, I heard Kit Orrie band with Donald Howard, a session they made there, and I don't know why, I've heard Donald Howard several times since on record and he hasn't been impressive at all. On that particular record he was very impressive. I was particularly struck by it. In fact, I would say that probably, now I'm thinking of the answers to much earlier questions, Rod Kless with the Maxi Spania band was a strong influence on me because the Spania records were just coming out, I'd rush…
